summary.name: Solo
summary.one_liner: Solo is an AI website builder that creates a business website from a few simple inputs, but it is closing down and will cease operations on Nov 30, 2026.
keywords: make a website for my business
use_cases: find an alternative website platform after shutdown
transfer a domain registration away from Solo
summary.what_it_does: The page says Solo creates a beautiful website for a business from a few simple inputs, and it was listed as free AI website creation with domain hosting. However, the page now states that registrations are closed and Solo will be closing down, ceasing operations on Nov 30, 2026. It points current customers to a support page for downloading website data, the subscription refund policy, moving a Solo Domains registration, and alternative platforms. Contact is support@soloist.ai. No feature details beyond the description are given on this page.
notable: AI generation of a business website from a few simple inputs
Includes Solo Domains registration and hosting
Service is shutting down; registrations are closed
caveats: Registrations are closed and new sign-ups are not possible
Service will cease operations on Nov 30, 2026
Listed as free on the directory, but the page itself does not state current pricing
